name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2023-10-18.21.1) introduced by Mayo MP [Rebekha Sharkie](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/mayo/rebekha_sharkie), which means it will be included in the bill. ### What does the amendment do? Ms Sharkie [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2023-10-18.21.1): > *The reason for this amendment is really around transparency and accountability.
